shortDescription: Asian refiners have increased purchases of Argentinian crude as the Iran war disrupts Middle East supply and intensifies competition for barrels from other regions, according to Bloomberg.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Asian Refiners Boost Argentinian Crude Purchases as Iran War Disrupts Supply
